defs.def: to make a judgement about the nature or quality of sb/sth 评估，评定（性质、质量）

ex.s: They use their noses to assess their environment and look out for any signs of danger.
ex.t: 它们用鼻子来评估周围环境，并留意任何危险的迹象。

ex.s: How does a pet cat assess different situations?
ex.t: 宠物猫如何评估不同的情况？
评估他们的心血管能力

ex.s: Many people enjoy relaxing music in the evening prior to going to bed．____37____While the validity of the idea is still being assessed，the lowered stress can even be tied back to blood pressure．Similarly, according to researchers，listening to just 30 minutes of soft music every day may help with healthy blood sugar levels， through the lowering of stress and anxiety．
ex.t: 许多人喜欢在晚上睡前听放松的音乐。____37____虽然这种观点的有效性仍在评估中但压力的降低甚至可能与血压有关。同样根据研究人员每天只需听30分钟轻音乐就可能通过减轻压力和焦虑有助于健康的血糖水平，

ex.s: The researchers analyzed video recordings of 53 child-parent pairs during everyday activities at home and found children who play with puzzles between 26 and 46 months of age have better spatial skills when assessed at 54 months of age.
ex.t: 研究人员分析了53对儿童-父母在家中进行日常活动的视频记录，发现26至46个月大的孩子玩拼图后，在54个月大时评估空间技能更好。

ex.s: Researchers from the University of Leipzig in Germany gathered more than 1, 000 retired workers who were over age 75 and assessed the volunteers’ memory and thinking skills through a battery of tests.
ex.t: 德国莱比锡大学的研究人员召集了1000多名75岁以上的退休工人，通过一系列测试评估志愿者的记忆力和思维能力。
评估学生的公共演讲技能

ex.s: To assess the consequences of ocean colour changes
ex.t: 浮游植物已被用于控制全球气候

ex.s: Before the heavy lifting began, the team assessed the root system and dug a five-foot-deep cylinder , measuring 40 feet in diameter, around the trunk to protect all essential roots.
ex.t: 插图详细描述了随后发生的事情。——莱斯利·内莫

defs.def: to calculate the amount or value of sth 估算，估定，核定（数量、价值）

ex.s: Assess and find out what’s going wrong and draw up a plan of action.
ex.t: 正如一条评论所说，"微笑是每个人都能理解的通用语言。"

ex.s: Bobby was assessed and his talents was / were revealed to be mostly scientific: a 66% chance of success in chemistry and 54% in physics was / were shown.
ex.t: 当我在学校专注于学习时，我的目标是上大学。

ex.s: Assess each other’s work according to the checklist.
ex.t: D. 以赢得他的英语测试为目标。

ex.s: Whatever it is, I know I need to inquire and assess what is going on.
ex.t: 这本书旨在解释好的身体姿势和健康的骨骼结构的重要性。

ex.s: Use this checklist to help you assess your partner’s draft.
ex.t: 他快步走到教室，发现学生们/已经……
